definitions.explanation: A division or subdivision of a text, document, or speech. Used for chapters in academic writing, verses in music or poetry, and sections of legal documents.
A particular time or season. Appears in compounds related to seasonal divisions and occasions.
Self-control or moderation in behavior. Used in expressions about maintaining proper boundaries.

examples.japanese: {第|だい}{三章|さんしょう}{第|だい}{二節|にせつ}を{読|よ}んでください。
この{歌|うた}は{三|さん}{節|せつ}ある。
{論文|ろんぶん}の{各|かく}{節|せつ}にまとめを{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I added a summary to each section of the paper.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}に{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}しやすい。
examples.english: It's easy to get sick at the change of seasons.

examples.japanese: {節分|せつぶん}に{豆|まめ}をまく。
{節目|ふしめ}の{年|とし}を{迎|むか}えた。
{節度|せつど}ある{行動|こうどう}を{心|こころ}がける。
{飲|の}み{過|す}ぎないよう{節制|せっせい}している。
examples.english: I'm exercising restraint so as not to drink too much.

examples.japanese: {何事|なにごと}も{節度|せつど}が{大切|たいせつ}で、やり{過|す}ぎは{禁物|きんもつ}だ。
examples.english: Moderation is important in everything — going overboard is a no-no.

notes:
A highly versatile kanji with meanings spanning textual divisions, seasonal markers, and moderation. The reading せつ (on'yomi) is used in compounds; the kun'yomi ふし is a separate entry.

COMMON COMPOUNDS (section/text):
- {章節|しょうせつ} — chapters and sections
- {条節|じょうせつ} — clauses and sections

COMMON COMPOUNDS (season/time):
- {季節|きせつ} — season
- {節分|せつぶん} — Setsubun (Feb. 3, bean-throwing festival)
- {節気|せっき} — solar term

COMMON COMPOUNDS (moderation):
- {節度|せつど} — moderation, propriety
- {節制|せっせい} — temperance, self-restraint
- {節約|せつやく} — economizing, saving
- {節電|せつでん} — power saving
- {節水|せっすい} — water conservation

DIFFERENT READINGS:
- {節|せつ} — section; season; moderation (this entry)
- {節|ふし} — joint; knot; melody; point (separate entry)
